products.name: Waveshare ESP32-P4-MODULE-16MB
products.summary: 16 MiB Flash / 32 MiB PSRAM；精确套件 SKU，裸模块/载板数字外设子集。

sources.title: 官方原厂镜像适用板表

limitations: 当前虚拟芯片使用 P4 rev3.1 / ECO5 ROM；硬件修订版须按实物确认，不能把该虚拟版本等同于全部在售实物。
当前为部分数字外设适配；DSI、CSI、C5/C6 无线协处理器、以太网及模拟电源行为尚未在此板验证。
此 profile 不附加 TF 卡或 ES8311；Core-DEV-KIT 没有板载 TF／音频，裸模块也不继承扩展载板器件。
商城 With/Without IPEX 选项指射频连接器，不是排针；带 IPEX 两个 SKU 当次商城显示不可售。
未确认此精确模块／选项的独立原厂恢复镜像；通用 ESP-IDF hello_world 作为独立示例，不冒充出厂固件。
精确 SKU 28101：排针、天线、相机、PoE 与附屏套件按商品页逐项区分；芯片修订版不是另一个 SKU。
3D 可视来源尚在转换；暂不宣称机械装配或屏幕原厂运行通过。
此 SKU 不含显示器；原厂恢复镜像的外接屏需求不会隐式变成板载屏幕。
已调查官方模块资料与当前平台原厂清单，未找到该裸模块专用原厂镜像；默认通用 Hello 示例明确为 example，不冒充出厂体验。
3D 来源：official-cad；生产Three加载器、来源哈希、尺寸和适用部分的射线/展开复位已检验；部分结构和光学尺寸有明确限制，未宣称浏览器WebGL或实物装配通过。
Model: No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Model: Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.
Model: This asset depicts the exact retained manufacturer assembly. Materials and unidentified component semantics are approximate; dimensions and all native relative placements remain unscaled.

Model: Packaged cameras, external display, speaker, PoE add-on, antenna cables and other optional accessories absent from sourceCAD are not fabricated as included geometry. Exact packaging remains in product knowledge.
Model: BOOT uses a verified product input control where present. No GPIO hit target is placed on an uncalibrated native component; bare modules do not gain a nonexistent button or codec.
Model: No Ethernet/radio/DSI/CSI/analog hardware or firmware execution is established by this mechanical model.

Model: Native source has no explicit16/32MiB SKUlabel. Its cornercomponent281 has a socket-like nativegeometry; comparison to officialno-IPEX photos showing an unpopulated RFfootprint supports selecting this component only for theIPEX option. This is visualcomponentclassification, not an identified connectorpart or certifiedSKUrevision. No-IPEX variant explicitly omits281; other281sourcecomponents remain unchanged. Manufacturer-datasheetPDF contains schematics, not placementdimensions.
Model: No-IPEX selection omits only the optionalcorner socket-likecomponent281. Empty pads and unresolvedfinepackage detail are not replaced with fabricatedantenna geometry.

chronology.notes: Hardware release date unverified; storefront position is a scheduling proxy, not a release date.

firmwares.name: P4 rev3 · ESP-IDF Hello World（通用示例）
limitations: 仅验证 ROM、CPU、串口，不证明厂家固件、PSRAM 初始化、全部板载外设或实物兼容性。
示例按 2 MiB Flash 布局构建；主控仍保留其物理 16/32 MiB Flash。

tests.scope: Exact carrier profile + guest route tests; no factory boot or WebGL claim.

tests.command: CARGO_TARGET_DIR={lane-target} CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo test --release -p esp32p4 --test waveshare
tests.scope: RISC-V guest instructions routeI2C0 SDA7/SCL8, write/read ES8311 control register0x32, and sample GPIO35 after actual BOOT button press/release. Host writes only guest program RAM and physical input events, then inspects result RAM. All27 platform profiles checked; module/codec absence mustNACK. Existing knob wrong-SDA control and external-panel-vs-bare identity probes remain.

Actual productionThree loader, retainedsourcehashes, native geometry bounds, framebuffer rays, shellmaterial isolation, UNKNOWN label construction/exposure and inspection restoration. No WebGL or physical fit claim.

limitations: Board and packaging variants explicit. Unmodeled MIPI-DSI/CSI/radio/Ethernet/analog/audio are not replaced by synthetic output.
Model conversion pending for this family.
integrationNotes: Use esp32p4::board::waveshare_platform::profile for exact memory and silicon selection.
Only panel-included SKU uses kit runtime; base SKU has no display.
